title: RCF ⇄ RPM Relationship

references.label: General microbiology/quantitative methods references (ASM, FDA BAM)

explanation: Relates a centrifuge's rotational speed (RPM) to the relative centrifugal force (RCF, expressed as a multiple of Earth's gravity, ×g) actually experienced by the sample, which depends on both speed and the radius from the rotation axis to the sample.

variables.meaning: Rotor radius (distance from spindle center to the point of interest, per the specific rotor's documented measurement convention)

workedExample.scenario: A rotor radius of 10 cm spinning at 5000 RPM.

commonMistakes: Using a generic 'typical' rotor radius instead of the actual radius specified for the rotor in use — RCF at a given RPM varies substantially between rotors of different sizes.
